in_arabic.name: قدر
in_arabic.meaning: Powerful, Capable, Masterful, Sovereign, Lord, Ruler, King
in_arabic.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r' which means power, capability, mastery, sovereignty, lordship, and rulership. It is often used to describe someone who is powerful, capable, and in control. The name Quadir can be translated to English as powerful, capable, masterful, sovereign, lord, ruler, or king.
